rv.q: Unfortunately, director Terrence I. Mosley’s production exudes a lethargy the performers cannot shake.
At its current state, the play falls victim to a lack of action, as major points are talked about rather than seen.
The atmosphere is brimming with tension, although the show is slow and nothing really happens.

cn.t: Critics find this John Hinckley Jr. drama benefits from strong performances but struggles with its uncomfortable subject matter, earning middling reviews that acknowledge its ambition while questioning its execution.
